scope: packed strips in committed public atlas; Gojo dash and superDash excluded by task carve-out

bodySheet.method: B = sqrt(opaque px in the fighter's bodyColors (art/scale/builds.json, sheet colours within RGB 8) / the same on idle f0), per packed frame; head = anims.json scaleAudit frame head (null = not read). median = median B of the strip; flag big > 1.12, small < 0.88. Advisory: +-10 % pose noise, confirm by body segments (art/CHARACTER_SCALE.md Body sheet).
